wiki.title: Ernie Otten
wiki.extract: Ernest 'Ernie' E. Otten, Jr. (born June 29, 1954) is an American politician and a Republican member of the South Dakota Senate and Majority Whip of said chamber representing District 6 since January 1, 2025, having previously represented this seat from January 1, 2013 to January 1, 2021. He previously served in the South Dakota House of Representatives from 2021 to 2025.
